relationships.subject: resiniferatoxin
relationships.evidence_quote: RTX-induced neuropathy is associated with α2δ-1 upregulation in the dorsal root ganglion (DRG)

relationships.subject: α2δ-1
relationships.evidence_quote: increased physical interaction between α2δ-1 and GluN1 in the spinal cord synaptosomes

relationships.subject: NMDA receptor
relationships.evidence_quote: RTX treatment augmented the frequency of miniature excitatory postsynaptic currents (mEPSCs) and the amplitude of evoked EPSCs in spinal dorsal horn neurons, and these effects were reversed by blocking NMDA receptors with AP-5

relationships.subject: gabapentin
relationships.evidence_quote: Inhibiting α2δ-1 with gabapentin, genetically ablating α2δ-1, or targeting α2δ-1-bound NMDA receptors with α2δ-1Tat peptide largely normalized the baseline frequency of mEPSCs

relationships.subject: memantine
relationships.evidence_quote: systemic treatment with memantine or gabapentin and intrathecal injection of AP-5 or Tat-fused α2δ-1 C terminus peptide reversed allodynia in RTX-treated rats and mice

relationships.subject: α2δ-1
relationships.evidence_quote: RTX-induced tactile allodynia was attenuated in α2δ-1 knock-out mice and in mice in which GluN1 was conditionally knocked out in DRG neurons

relationships.subject: α2δ-1
relationships.evidence_quote: originally considered a calcium channel subunit, serves as an auxiliary protein that promotes activation of presynaptic NMDA receptors and pain hypersensitivity

key_findings: RTX-induced small-fiber neuropathy upregulates α2δ-1 in DRG neurons and increases α2δ-1–GluN1 interaction in spinal synaptosomes.
α2δ-1-bound presynaptic NMDA receptors potentiate nociceptive input to the dorsal horn and drive RTX-induced tactile allodynia.
